SELECT toTypeName(arrayMap((multiply(_1, _2) | toString) | CONCAT('$', _), CAST([2], 'Array(Float64)'), CAST([3], 'Array(UInt8)')))
SELECT toTypeName(arrayMap((x, y) -> (x * y), CAST([2], 'Array(Int32)'), CAST([3], 'Array(UInt8)')))
SELECT toTypeName(arrayMap(xs -> arrayMap(x -> x, xs), CAST([[1]], 'Array(Array(UInt16))')))
SELECT toTypeName(arrayMap(x -> arrayMap(y -> CONCAT(x, y), CAST(['b'], 'Array(String)')), CAST(['a'], 'Array(String)')))
SELECT toTypeName(arrayMap(x -> arrayMap(x -> lower(x), CAST(['B'], 'Array(String)')), CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)')))

WITH
    (x -> upper(x)) AS trim
SELECT toTypeName(arrayMap(trim | upper, ['x']))
